prompt: I was on the Free plan last year, but I upgraded to the Pro plan back in March. Does my account currently include Pro-tier priority support?

messages.content: You are a helpful assistant with access to tools. When you need information from the workspace, or need to run a command, call the appropriate tool. Once you have enough information to answer, reply directly with the answer in plain text and do NOT call any more tools.
I was on the Free plan last year, but I upgraded to the Pro plan back in March. Does my account currently include Pro-tier priority support?

events.reply:
I don't have any way to look up your account, billing history, or current subscription status, so I can't confirm what plan you're on right now or what support tier is active.

What I can tell you generally:

- If your Pro subscription has remained active and in good standing since you upgraded in March, then yes—priority support is part of the Pro tier, so it would be included.
- However, I can't verify that your account is *currently* on Pro. Things like a downgrade, a failed payment, or a cancellation could have changed your status since March.

To get a definitive answer, check the Billing or Subscription section of your account settings, where your current plan and renewal status are shown. If anything looks off, contacting support directly (using the email on file, [redacted-email]) will let them confirm your entitlements.
